author: seifsg
name: Linkseed
tagline: Free listing pages for makers, with a link you earn by verifying your site.
description:
List your app or website through a short GitHub form and get a fast public page that links to it.

The link starts as ugc nofollow. Add a meta tag or the Linkseed badge to your site and the next check turns it into a followed link. No accounts, no payments, no queue.
